263. Telegram 85263 From the
Department of
                                State
to the
Embassy in India
1
2
Washington
,
May 16, 1972, 0035Z
Subject:
AID Staff in India
1.
We believe it is important that Ministry of Finance be aware that
                                Indian request for reduction of
US
AID
staff has been carefully
                                considered by Washington. Therefore
AID
Director should return promptly to
DEA
and convey instructions in State
                                9819, making clear our desire to consider jointly with Ministry of
                                Finance minimum staffing needs in all categories of personnel,
                                including technical assistance, to meet Indian and U.S. priorities
                                for various programs.
2.
We note that mission has informed Ministry that fifty-nine
                                Americans on
US
AID
staff will depart by next
                                September without being replaced. Joint review with
GOI
should therefore focus on remaining
                                staff. We wish to follow course of these discussions carefully.
                                Embassy should therefore report fully discussions with
GOI
officials.
